messages:
Maya Patel: AtlasEdge asked for an early-renewal offer: move 30 seats from 'data-sandbox' to 'data-prod', request 11% early-sign discount if DocuSign completed by 2024-12-09, and a prorated credit for the remainder of the term on the vacated seats. They also want billing switched to AtlasEdge Ltd (UK). Need finance/procurement/legal/onboarding.
Jordan Kim: 11% needs finance sign-off. Do we have current ARR and invoice ref? Also confirm whether they want credit as invoice adjustment or cash refund.
Maya Patel: Current ARR for full account = $200k. The 30 seats are $50/mo each on annual term. They prefer invoice credit, not refund. They plan to reference INV-7777 on PO.
Samir Patel: Legal: we'll need an amendment and an updated SOW with seat allocation table and effective date. Standard prorate calc ok. Add a clause that the amendment is final settlement for seat claims.
Liam O'Connor: Draft clause snippet I'll add:

```
Prorated Credit = seat_price * (remaining_days / 365) * number_of_seats
Applied as an invoice adjustment referencing INV-7777 within two billing cycles.
```

Also include: "No further concessions after amendment execution." Uploading redline shortly.
Sophie Tran: Onboarding: seat move requires SSO group remap + user CSV. I can run migration script but need the CSV and a 30-min maintenance window. Recommend Saturday 2024-12-07 03:00 UTC.
Maya Patel: I'll request PO tonight and ask them to sign by 2024-12-08 to be safe. Procurement said they might need the UK billing name and VAT (they provided VAT GB999000111).
billing-bot: Provisional credit estimate created: https://billing.internal/adj/PE-1736543210-ATLAS - estimate uses formula: $50 * remaining_days/365 * 30.
procure-bot: PO request created. Awaiting PO# from AtlasEdge procurement (please route PO to procurement@redwood.com and include reference INV-7777).
Jordan Kim: Finance: tentatively approve 11% if: 1) signed PO references INV-7777, 2) DocuSign complete by 2024-12-09, 3) billing entity VAT provided. If any missing, discount drops to 7%.
Samir Patel: Redline uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/addenda/atlas-early-renewal_v1.docx - includes prorate formula and settlement language. Legal ok with invoice-credit-only approach.
Sophie Tran: Send CSV to onboarding@redwood.com with subject "Atlas-seat-move-30" by EOD 2024-12-03. I will schedule the migration once PO & signed amendment present.
Maya Patel: Thanks all 44d I'll post PO and user list here when they arrive and will route DocuSign to renewals@atlasedge.com cc legal@redwood.com.
